verdict.rationale: Make's official MCP server gives AI clients like Claude and ChatGPT scenario management tools that can view and modify scenarios (make-docs-3, make-docs-14, make-docs-20). Make Skills help an assistant build scenarios and configure modules (make-docs-4). Together these let a user create or edit workflows from a prompt, but only through an external AI assistant, not a native in-product prompt-to-workflow builder. missing for 10: a native in-editor natural-language scenario generator, detailed docs on prompt-driven scenario creation, independent or hands-on corroboration that generated scenarios work.
